ety: ตัดทอนจาก กระทำ; ร่วมเชื้อสายกับลาว ທຳ (ทำ)
rule: ทำ is the bare verb DO, and its senses differ only by what the object is. The working test is that object: sense 2 takes the THING PRODUCED, 3 takes the FIELD one works in, 4 takes the TASK carried out. So ทำครัว files at 3 beside ทำนา and ทำสวน — the kitchen is a field of work, not a product — while ทำการบ้าน, ทำความสะอาด, ทำคลอด and ทำแท้ง are tasks and file at 4 with ทำงาน. Sense 7, performing the rite pertaining to a thing, takes ทำขวัญ and ทำบุญ. Sense 8, แสดง, takes the whole family in which the object is the manner one presents — ทำที, ทำท่า, ทำเนียน, ทำตัว. Sense 1, the bare กระทำ, keeps the causatives whose object is simply an effect: ทำร้าย, ทำพิษ, ทำให้, and the poetic รันทำ, ตี + กระทำ. Senses 2, 5, 6 and 9 take nothing here, and each for a plain reason: their compounds are ทำอาหาร and ทำบ้าน, ทำผม and ทำเล็บ, ทำตามกฎ, ทำปริญญา — none of which is in this queue. The trap on this head is the Khmer infix: FOUR of nineteen words are ทำ- infixed stems, not compounds at all.

It only compares rather than derives, so probable — but the recorded split would read ทำ 'to do' + นอง 'to flood', which is not a reading anyone would defend, and the Khmer word matches this one in both form and sense.

notes.h2: 2026-09-06 (third run) — ชาติ, ทำ, ชน (47 filed, 6 tagged false-split, 3 left)
notes.h3: ทำ (tham-2) — 15 filed, FOUR tagged false-split
notes.text:
**The trap on this head is the Khmer infix**, and it took four of nineteen:
**ทำนบ** (*แผลงมาจาก ทบ, จากเขมร ទំនប់*), **ทำลาย** (*แผลงมาจาก ทลาย*, Old Angkorian
ទ្លាយ៑), **ทำนาย** (*แผลงมาจาก ทาย*, cf. Khmer ទំនាយ) and **ทำนอง** — that last one
tagged `probable`, because the dictionary only says *เทียบเขมร ទំនង* rather than
deriving it. That is now the fourth head where the ทำ-/ดำ-/สำ- infix has masqueraded
as a compound. **It is worth a corpus-wide pass**: any compound whose etymology
contains แผลงมาจาก and whose head is the first syllable is a false split, and the
list of susceptible heads is short — ดำ, ตำ, ทำ, สำ, จำ, กำ, บรร, ประ.

notes.h2: 2026-09-06 (third run) — ชาติ, ทำ, ชน (47 filed, 6 tagged false-split, 3 left)
notes.h3: ทำ (tham-2) — 15 filed, FOUR tagged false-split
notes.text:
**รันทำ is a real compound and stays.** Its first element is รัน *ตี*, to strike,
so รันทำ is strike-and-do, ย่ำยี — sense 1. Note in passing that the RID's รัน entry
carries two glosses, *ตี* and *ทำให้โปรแกรมทำงาน*, with an etymology
(*ยืมมาจากอังกฤษ run*) that covers only the second. **One entry, two words.**
